defeaters: The only way to verify a surface would be to import external corpus text into the public repo.
A producer would have to be trusted on the caller's word rather than reproduced from the repository.
Granting the producer may_resolve would let an observation resolve an iʿrāb-sensitive decision.

evidence_policy.fabrication_rule: If no repository source can verify a per-word written surface, do NOT add a local table: leave the surface bound-but-unverified, keep producer trust at fixture, and escalate.
evidence_policy.statement: Every claim about coordinate or surface coverage must be produced by running the commands above against the committed indexes. No authority may be asserted from documentation prose.

expected_outputs.description: OBSERVATION_PRODUCERS extended with a repository-resident producer, and the surface check upgraded from bound-and-compared to verified, only if an authority exists
the evidence-authority limitation reconciled to the measured result
the producer contract, its trust level, and the measured coverage of the coordinate and surface authorities

guards: The METHOD (name the missing authority, fail closed to candidate, and packetize it) transfers; the specific occurrences used as fixtures are never occurrence claims and never transfer.
A producer may not be granted may_resolve=True without a repository-resident, reproducible producer; raising trust by fiat is exactly the caller-forgeable evidence this packet exists to remove.
Observations remain candidate-only until BOTH authorities exist; agreement is never certification.
No local coordinate authority may be invented inside a naḥw helper; tools/fusha_check.resolve_address over the committed spine stays the only coordinate oracle.

SERIALIZED WRITE SCOPE (dispatch order 1 of 5): this packet shares write paths tools/fusha_nahw_particle_rules.py, docs/subsystems/nahw-executable-map.md with the other TP-NAHW-A2-* packets and MUST NOT be dispatched concurrently with them. Run only after no predecessor (this is the first packet) have landed, and before TP-NAHW-A2-HOVER-KEY-SEAT, TP-NAHW-A2-STATE-VOCAB, TP-NAHW-A2-TYPED-STATE-CONSUMER, TP-NAHW-A2-TYPED-WR-BANK. Re-measure the runner and the harness after each predecessor: a concurrent run would interleave edits to the same eval bank and the same runner file.

non_deployment.statement: This packet builds internal evidence machinery only. It certifies nothing, publishes no hover, and never writes to the live site or the entry store; all outcomes stay candidate-mode inside this repository.

scope.summary: tools/fusha_nahw_particle_rules.typed_observation validates an observation artifact on five axes: shape, authorized producer, canonical coordinate (against qamus/indexes/current/quran-usage-spine-full.jsonl via tools/fusha_check.resolve_address), binding to the exact token/surface/state/referent, and content integrity. Two authorities are missing. (1) OBSERVATION_PRODUCERS contains only nahw-a2-fixture-observer, whose trust is `fixture` and whose may_resolve is False, so no observation can promote a decision past `candidate`. (2) The spine carries token COUNTS and glosses, not per-word written surfaces, so occurrence.surface is bound and compared but never verified against a repository authority. A2 deliberately did not invent either authority. This packet supplies them.

title: no repository producer signs naḥw observation artifacts and no per-word written-surface authority exists, so every observation stays fixture-trust and candidate-only
